caption: Two small black toy cars begins their journey across a detailed map of Northern Europe. They smoothly roll forward, tracing a path over the intricate lines and names of countries. The car's glossy surface reflects the ambient light, creating a playful contrast against the muted colors of the map. The wheels turn steadily, as if embarking on an adventurous road trip across the vast, printed landscape.
